Agenda #1: Approval of the Annual Report, Financial Statements, and full discharge (acquit et de charge) for FY2025, including the Board of Commissioners' supervisory report. Approved with 99.9924% in favor, 0.0076% against, and no abstentions.
Agenda #2: Approval of the use of net profit for FY2025, deciding not to distribute dividends and instead allocate retained earnings as working capital and for capital contributions or investments in subsidiaries and associates. Approved unanimously by acclamation with no dissenting votes or abstentions.
Agenda #3: Approval of remuneration for the Board of Commissioners and Directors for January to December 2026, including delegation to the Nomination and Remuneration Committee to determine individual amounts for commissioners and to set division of duties and remuneration for the Board of Directors. Approved by consensus with no dissenting votes or abstentions.
Agenda #4: Appointment of Public Accounting Firm Mirawati Sensi Idris and Public Accountant Denny Susanto to audit the 2026 financial statements, with authority granted to the Board of Directors to set honorarium and to the Board of Commissioners to appoint a replacement if necessary. Approved with 99.9928% in favor, 0.0072% against, and no abstentions.
Agenda #5: Approval of the report on the realization of the use of proceeds from the public offering of Sinar Mas Multiartha Continuous Bonds III Phase I 2024, Phase III 2025, and Phase IV 2025. Approved with 99.9996% in favor, 0.0004% against, and no abstentions.
